[Thinking]
**Summarizing age estimates**

I need to provide a concise answer regarding the age of the universe. As of 2024-2026, the Planck mission estimates it at 13.80 ± 0.02 billion years, with a more precise measurement being 13.797±0.023 billion years. There are discussions around new results like JWST, but 13.8 billion years seems to be the best estimate. I can mention the range of 13.7 to 13.8 and point to the ΛCDM model used for this assessment. Keeping it brief is essential!
[/Thinking]

About 13.8 billion years. The best current estimate, from Planck satellite measurements of the cosmic microwave background within the standard ΛCDM model, is roughly 13.8 ± 0.02 billion years.
